title: Page timing at 375px
notes: TIER IS WATCH, NOT GATE (design §4.7: 'watch → gate'), same reason as touch-targets (builder A8): this worktree has no dev server or DATABASE_URL (standing 'a worktree has no .env.local either' gotcha), so e2e/bench-page-timing.spec.ts could not actually be run here to establish today's real numbers. Promote to gate once a CI run with a live server + seeded cohort (npx tsx scripts/bench/seed-cohort.ts) confirms real p95s under the floor. The 800ms floor on every metric is design §4.7's adopted default (plan item 1, floors marked †) applied uniformly to both server-response (p95_ttfb_ms_*, Navigation Timing's responseStart) and DOMContentLoaded (p95_dcl_ms_*, domContentLoadedEventEnd) for each of the four hottest pages named in the task brief — the student home (/dashboard), the student jobs page (/career — /jobs is a redirect stub to /career#jobs, the repo's retired-route pattern), the teacher dashboard (/teacher), and the Connect console (/teacher/connect). Each metric is a p95 over 5 repeated navigations (e2e/bench-page-timing.spec.ts's REPEATS), read from the freshly-loaded document's own Navigation Timing entry after each goto.
